name: What happens if blood on walls is not cleaned properly?

mainEntity.name: What happens if blood on walls is not cleaned properly?

acceptedAnswer.text: Improper cleanup of blood on walls can lead to several serious issues. Health risks are paramount, as residual bloodborne pathogens can remain, posing a threat of infection. Incomplete cleaning also often results in persistent odors that are difficult to remove. Additionally, organic matter left behind can promote mold growth, further damaging the structure and affecting indoor air quality. Visually, stains may reappear or remain, diminishing the property's appearance and potentially reducing its value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Improper blood cleanup can leave behind pathogens, cause persistent odors, lead to mold growth, and result in permanent stains, posing health risks and damaging the property.
